'''Seboca''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
[[File:Rednax_and_Seboca.png|thumb|left|180px|Seboca (back) in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]]]
Seboca dated an [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] named [[Bogg Tyrell/Legends|Bogg Tyrell]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was riding in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] with Bogg, when it was almost hit by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

In that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he starred in the production ''[[Airtaxi Driver]]''.

Seboca was also present in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] conversing with [[Rednax/Legends|Rednax]] and [[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Slyther Bushforb]], at the same time Obi-Wan Kenobi was there talking to [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]].

==Behind the scenes==
Seboca was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']].

Early sources are confusing when it comes to identifying the Dugs in Dex's Diner. [[Behind the Magic|''Behind the Magic: Dexter's Diner'']] states that "Manoca" is the spotted Dug in the foreground with his back to us, while [[StarWars.com|''Episode II DVD-ROM Exclusive Content'']] indicates that Manoca is the other Dug without spots. The [[Databank (original)|Databank]], however, states that the Dug believed to be Manoca is actually Seboca. [[Leland Chee]] recently confirmed that it is indeed Seboca in Dex's Diner,<ref name="Blog-holocron|29">{{Blog|holocron|29|Mistaken Identities}}</ref> and Slyther Bushforb's Databank entry has since clarified that Manoca is an alias of Seboca's.<ref name="DB Bushforb">{{DB|character|slytherbushforb|Bushforb, Slyther}}</ref>

In the final chapter of ''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]'' found on [[StarWars.com]], Seboca is identified as a [[Air taxi/Legends|taxi]] driver.

[[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] created Seboca's digital character model by modifying the [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] model from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> It was also used to represent a Dug introduced in the [[Star Wars: The Complete Saga|Blu-ray]] release of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]. Despite the characters' identical appearance, they have yet to be identified as one and the same.
